title: Northern Ireland Multiple Deprivation Measure 2017
description: NIMDM 2017 multiple deprivation measure and domain ranks for Northern Ireland, at 2001 super output area level and, as a companion, at 2014 electoral ward level.
publisher: Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency

files.note: NIMDM17 SOA-level results workbook, published 23 November 2017 (https://www.nisra.gov.uk/publications/nimdm17-results). Holds the SOA2001 tables including the "Domain Ranks" sheet; contains no ward-level data.

CSV of the workbook's SOA domain-rank table, read by the loader. 890 super output areas x 13 columns, followed by trailing blank rows from the spreadsheet export. Header cells contain embedded newlines (e.g. "Multiple Deprivation Measure Rank \n(where 1 is most deprived)"). Codes are NISRA's SOA2001 identifiers such as 95AA01S1, joined here to the NI_SOA_2011 boundaries this repo ships.

NIMDM17 results restated for the 2014 electoral wards, a separate NISRA release published 26 July 2018 (https://www.nisra.gov.uk/publications/nimdm17-ward2014-results). 462 wards x 12 columns. Kept for provenance; no loader reads it, and it is not derived from NIMDM17_SOAresults.xls.
